title: 국군포로의 송환 및 대우 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of National Defense ( Arms Control and Non-Proliferation Policy Division ), 02-748-6257

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「국군포로의 송환 및 대우 등에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Repatriation and Treatment, etc. of Prisoners of War and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended June 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(귀환포로등의 등록신청등) ①「국군포로의 송환 및 대우 등에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제6조제1항 및 「국군포로의 송환 및 대우 등에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제3조제1항에 따라 등록신청을 하고자 하는 귀환포로는 별지 제1호서식의 귀환포로 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)를 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Registration, etc. of Repatriated Prisoners of War, etc.) ① A repatriated prisoner of war who wishes to apply for registration pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Repatriation and Treatment, etc. of Prisoners of War, etc. of the Armed Forces (hereinafter referred to as the “Act ” ) and Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Repatriation and Treatment, etc. of Prisoners of War,referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit the Application for Registration of Repatriated Prisoners of War in the form of Annex No. 1 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Minister of National Defense. <Amended June 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ②법 제6조제1항 및 영 제3조제1항에 따라 등록신청을 하고자 하는 억류지출신 포로가족은 별지 제2호서식의 억류지출신 포로가족 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 사망한 국군포로 또는 귀환포로의 억류지출신 가족임을 입증할 수 있는 자료를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: ② A family member of a prisoner of war from a detention camp who wishes to apply for registration pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense an Application for Registration of a Family Member of a Prisoner of War from a Detention Camp (Form No. 2 ) (including applications submitted as electronic documents), attaching materials proving that they are a family member of a deceased Korean War prisoner of war or a repatriated prisoner of war from a detention camp. <Amended June 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③제1항 및 제2항에 따른 신청을 받은 국방부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 국군포로 또는 귀환포로의 병적증명서를 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2009. 4. 1., 2010. 8. 13., 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of National Defense, upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, shall verify the military service certificates of prisoners of war or repatriated prisoners of war through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant documents. <Amended Apr. 1, 2009; Aug. 13, 2010; Jun. 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ④영 제3조제7항에 따른 귀환포로의 등록대장은 별지 제3호서식에, 억류지출신 포로가족의 등록대장은 별지 제4호서식에 따른다. <개정 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: ④ The register of repatriated prisoners of war pursuant to Article 3 , Paragraph 7 of the Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form , and the register of families of prisoners of war from detention camps shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(사회적응교육) 법 제6조의2 및 영 제4조의2에 따라 사회적응교육을 받으려는 등록포로는 별지 제4호의2서식의 사회적응교육 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)를 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Social Adaptation Education) A registered prisoner of war who wishes to receive social adaptation education pursuant to Article 6-2 of the Act and Article 4-2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for social adaptation education in the form of Annex 4-2 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Minister of National Defense. <Amended June 26, 2013>
[This Article Newly Inserted on April 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의3(유전자 검사의 서면동의) 영 제4조의3제2항에 따른 서면동의서(전자문서로 된 동의서를 포함한다)는 별지 제4호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2-3 (Written Consent for Genetic Testing) The written consent form pursuant to Article 4-3(2) of the Enforcement Decree (including a consent form in the form of an electronic document) shall be in accordance with Form No. 4-3 of the Attached Form.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 26, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(일시지원금의 우선 지급 신청) ①영 제7조제1항에 따라 일시지원금의 우선 지급을 신청하려는 사람은 별지 제5호서식의 국군포로 일시지원금 우선 지급 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 8. 13., 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Priority Payment of Temporary Support Funds) ①Any person who intends to apply for priority payment of temporary support funds pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense the Application for Priority Payment of Temporary Support Funds for POWs of the Armed Forces in the form of Annex 5 (including applications submitted as electronic documents), attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Aug. 13, 2010; Jun. 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국군포로와의 관계를 확인할 수 있는 서류(본인 외의 사람이 대리신청하는 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Documents verifying the relationship with the Korean War POW (limited to cases where a person other than the principal applies on their behalf)
1-2. Power of Attorney
2. Pledge
3. One copy of bank passbook for identity verification

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 국방부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 국군포로의 병적증명서, 신청인의 주민등록표 등본의 내용을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2009. 4. 1., 2010. 8. 13., 2013. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of National Defense shall verify the contents of the military service certificate of a prisoner of war and the certified copy of the applicant's resident registration record through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach such documents. <Amended Apr. 1, 2009; Aug. 13, 2010; Jun. 26, 2013>
[Title amended June 26, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(유족지원금의 신청) ① 영 제9조제1항에 따라 유족지원금 지급 신청을 하려는 사람은 별지 제6호서식의 유족지원금 지급 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류 중 해당하는 서류를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Survivor Support) ①Any person who intends to apply for survivor support in accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense an application for survivor support in the form of Annex 6 (including an application in electronic form), attaching the relevant documents among the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 등록포로의 사망사실을 확인할 수 있는 기본증명서 또는 사망진단서 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the basic certificate or death certificate confirming the death of the registered prisoner of war
2. One copy of Family Relationship Certificate
3. One copy of the Certificate of Marriage
4. One copy of documents verifying support
5. One copy of bank passbook for identity verification

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 국방부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 주민등록표 등본의 내용을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of National Defense shall verify the contents of a copy of the resident registration record through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the document.

[This Article was newly added on June 26, 2013.]
[Formerly Article 4 was moved to Article 7 <June 26, 2013>]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(유족지원금 수급권 상실 신고) 영 제9조제6항에 따른 유족지원금 수급권 상실 신고 의무자는 별지 제7호서식의 유족지원금 수급권 상실 신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류 중 해당하는 서류를 첨부하여 그 사유가 발생한 날부터 30일 이내에 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Reporting of Loss of Entitlement to Survivor Support Benefits) Persons obligated to report the loss of entitlement to survivor support benefits pursuant to Article 9 , Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a report on the loss of entitlement to survivor support benefits in the form of Annex No. 7 (including a report in electronic form) to the Minister of National Defense within 30 days from the date the cause occurred, attaching the relevant documents among the documents in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 유족지원금 수급권자의 사망사실을 확인할 수 있는 기본증명서 또는 사망증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Basic Certificate or Death Certificate confirming the fact of death of the beneficiary of the survivor's support payment.
2. One copy of Family Relationship Certificate
[This Article Newly Inserted June 26, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(주거지원의 신청) ① 영 제11조제2항에 따라 보증금 및 월세의 지급을 신청하려는 사람은 별지 제8호서식의 주거지원 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Housing Support) ①Any person who intends to apply for the payment of a security deposit and monthly rent pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense an application for housing support in Form No. 8 (including an application in electronic form) with the following documents attached.
1. One copy of the lease agreement
2. One copy of bank passbook for identity verification

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제11조제4항 단서에 따라 보증금 차액 지급을 신청하려는 사람은 별지 제9호서식의 보증금 차액 지급 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 본인 실명확인 통장 사본 1부를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who wishes to apply for payment of the difference in the deposit amount pursuant to the proviso of Article 11, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense an application for payment of the difference in the deposit amount (including an application in the form of an electronic document) in Form No. 9 attached thereto, with one copy of the bank passbook for verifying the person's real name attached.

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제11조제6항에 따라 공공건설임대주택 입주 지원을 신청하려는 사람은 별지 제10호서식의 공공건설임대주택 입주 지원 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)를 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ A person who intends to apply for support for occupancy in public construction rental housing pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the application for support for occupancy in public construction rental housing in Form No. 10 (including an application in electronic form) to the Minister of National Defense.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따른 신청을 받은 국방부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 주민등록표 등본의 내용을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of National Defense who receives an application pursuant to the provisions of paragraphs 1 through 3 shall verify the contents of a copy of the resident registration record through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the document.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 26, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(의료지원비의 신청) 법 제14조 및 영 제13조제1항에 따라 의료지원을 받으려는 등록포로는 별지 제11호서식의 등록포로 의료지원 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Medical Support Expenses) A ​​registered prisoner of war who wishes to receive medical support pursuant to Article 14 of the Act and Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense an Application for Medical Support for Registered Prisoners of War in the form of Annex No. 11 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) with any of the following documents attached.
1. Receipt for out-of-pocket medical expenses
2. Prescription and receipt for patient co-payment dispensing fee
3. Receipt for purchase of assistive devices

rows.source_ko: 4. 간병 실시 및 비용에 관한 증명 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents proving the provision of care and costs
5. Copy of bank passbook for identity verification
[Wholly Amended Dec. 30, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(국군포로 유해의 송환비용 지원신청) ① 법 제15조의2제1항 전단 및 영 제14조의2제1항에 따라 국군포로 유해의 송환에 지출된 비용을 지원받으려는 포로가족은 별지 제12호서식의 송환비용 지원금 지급신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Support for Repatriation Costs of Remains of Korean War Prisoners of War) ① Afamily of a prisoner of war who wishes to receive support for costs incurred for the repatriation of the remains of a Korean War prisoner of war pursuant to the first part of Article 15-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of National Defense an application for payment of repatriation cost support funds in the form of Annex No. 12 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) with the following documents attached.
1. Fare Receipt
2. Daily allowance receipt
3. Accommodation receipt
4. Food expense receipts
5. One copy of bank passbook for identity verification

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 분실 등의 사유로 제1항제1호부터 제4호까지의 서류를 제출할 수 없는 경우에는 그 밖에 운임, 일비, 숙박비, 식비의 지출을 증명할 수 있는 서류 등을 제출함으로써 이에 갈음할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if the documents specified in Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 through 4 cannot be submitted due to reasons such as loss, they may be substituted by submitting other documents proving the expenditure of transportation, daily allowances, accommodation expenses, and meal expenses.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 22, 2015]
